message: Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && grep -n "xmlTextReaderRead\|xmlXIncludeProcessNode\|xmlXIncludeProcessTree" xmlreader.c | head -20

message.content:
Now I understand the vulnerability. The key issue is:
1. `xmlXIncludeAddTxt` stores a pointer to a text node in `ctxt->txtTab`
2. The same text node is also set as `ctxt->incTab[nr]->inc` (the replacement content)
3. When the Reader processes the document, it can free the text node (since it's now part of the document tree)
4. Later, when another XInclude references the same text URL, `xmlXIncludeLoadTxt` tries to use `ctxt->txtTab[i]` which is now a dangling pointer

Let me look at how the Reader interacts with this. Let me check the xmlreader.c code:
